ddl.name: navigation_items_link
ddl.value:
NOT (
						"href" IS NOT NULL
						AND "entity_id" IS NOT NULL
					)

ddl.name: report_external_resource_snapshots_report_owner_xor_check
ddl.value:
(
					CASE WHEN "country_report_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
					+ CASE WHEN "working_group_report_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				) = 1

ddl.name: sessions_impersonation_expiry_check
ddl.value:
"impersonated_user_id" IS NULL
					OR "impersonation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: users_actor_xor_check
ddl.value:
NOT (
						"person_document_id" IS NOT NULL
						AND "organisational_unit_document_id" IS NOT NULL
					)
